summary: The ONLY network/CDN-delivered dynamic media in the reference app are third-party AdMob ad creatives, observed only on the reference-original (non-premium) run (splash app-open ad, native ad banner on Scanner home + Settings, interstitial on tab navigation, native ad inside the exit sheet). These are per-impression Google Mobile Ads content, not app-owned assets, and are OUT of the clone's product scope (ads = DEFERRED / premium-no-ads baseline is the clone target). Every image on an app-owned EVIDENCED screen is either (a) generated at runtime on-device (QR/barcode bitmaps) or (b) a bundled app resource (vector/webp/png). RemoteConfig / Play-billing supply dynamic config/pricing VALUES (e.g. ProX '263.000 ₫/tuần', ctaText, splash timers, region gate) — data, not media. The three bundled MLKit .tflite models are data artifacts (Step 3 §3), consumed by com.google.mlkit:barcode-scanning; the clone depends on the library rather than copying files.
